newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador sees 1997 growth at 4 to 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador sees 1997 growth at 4 to 5 pct.

text.p: El Salvador could post a growth rate of between four to five percent in its gross domestic product (GDP) in 1997 and an inflation rate of about five percent, the Central Reserve Bank said on Saturday.
"The outlook for this year is positive," the central bank said.
The central bank said that inflation in 1996 was eight percent, while GDP grew by three percent.
It said the budget deficit was two percent of GPD in 1996 but is seen falling to one percent of GDP in 1997.
